Generated Narrative: CodeSystem irun-exercise

This case-sensitive code system https://example.org/ig/interoperabilityrun/CodeSystem/irun-exercise defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
run-session Run sessionA completed Interoperability Run session (exercise summary).
distance Distance runTotal distance covered during the run.
average-pace Average paceAverage time per kilometre.
swim-session Swim sessionA completed swim session (e.g. an open-water swim alongside the run).
environment-conditions Environmental conditionsWeather and water conditions at the course during the event.
air-temperature Air temperatureOutdoor air temperature at the course.
relative-humidity Relative humidityOutdoor relative air humidity at the course.
water-temperature Water temperatureWater temperature for swimmers.
run-report Interoperability Run reportSummary report of a participant's run: vital signs, ECG, session and conditions.
preventive-checkup Preventive check-upPreventive care check-up around the Interoperability Run (vital signs before and after the run).
